name: ResourceHeader
title: Templates/Headers/ResourceHeader
summary: The console bar for every page inside the persistent shell, at its first and second level of resource. A `GlobalHeader` in its default `content` placement, sitting in the content zone beside the navigation rail. Start: the navigation trigger below `md`, the brand, and the breadcrumb from the second level. End: search first, then Create, the Agent button and the account avatar. The first level of a resource names itself with its own page, so the bar carries the brand alone; the second level adds the module and the resource name as a breadcrumb. Below `md` the sample collapses Create and Agent into icon buttons, and from a bar width of `--container-2xl` it widens the search into a field with the ⌘K shortcut. Both thresholds are read from the theme tokens. Built from `GlobalHeader`, `Breadcrumb`, `IconButton`, `Button`, `ButtonHighlight`, `Avatar` and `Brand`.

variants.name: SecondLevel
variants.summary: A resource inside a module. The breadcrumb names the module and the resource, and shows from `md`; the last crumb is the current page and carries no link.
